name: Dragon's Kingdom free asset library
rules: Free / open licences only (CC0 preferred; CC BY only with a CREDITS line). Every file has a source URL and a sha256.
Binaries are git-ignored: run `node assets-lib/fetch.mjs` to (re)download them. Commit only manifest.json, fetch.mjs, README.md, CREDITS.md, .gitignore.

status "available": reachable from the build container and locked (sha256). status "blocked": the host was refused by this environment's network policy on 2026-10-06; fetch.mjs downloads them once the hosts are allowed and records their sha256 with --lock.

assets.title: Umhlanga Sunrise
assets.author: Greg Zaal
assets.via: Google Research Kubric public mirror of Poly Haven HDRIs (gs://kubric-public/assets/HDRI_haven, CC0 1.0 per its HDRI_haven.json)
assets.use: Dawn over open sea: sun just above the sea horizon, altocumulus sky, unclipped sun (peak ~2.9e3). Prologue key light and sky reference; mask out the beach/buildings (use the sky only).

upgrade.why: 4k is fine for lighting/reflections; a visible 4K-frame sky needs 8k-16k. Fetch with --upgrades once dl.polyhaven.org is allowed.
